description: Convert a file opened with inspect_cad to STEP, STL or GLB and return a download link that expires in 30 minutes. STEP is a solid B-Rep when the source was read exactly; otherwise it is a triangulated STEP that CAD software cannot edit as a solid. STL and GLB are always triangulated meshes.

ref.description: The ref from an inspect_cad result. An upload_ticket is not a ref.

step_kind.description: Only for target=step: auto picks solid B-Rep when the source was exact else mesh STEP; solid forces B-Rep; mesh forces triangulated STEP.

target.description: Output format: step (CAD B-Rep or mesh STEP), stl (triangle mesh), or glb (glTF binary mesh).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for conversion to finish before returning status=running, 0–20, default 15.

name: convert_cad
title: Convert CAD file
